projects.title: Delivery Frenzy
projects.subtitle: Cooperative Multiplayer Delivery Game
projects.shortDescription: A fast-paced cooperative multiplayer delivery game where players work together to complete chaotic delivery missions under time pressure.
projects.fullDescription: delivery-frenzy is a cooperative multiplayer experience focused on teamwork, communication, and fast decision-making. Players take on the role of delivery agents navigating dynamic environments filled with obstacles, traffic systems, and time-based challenges. The game emphasizes coordination between players as they split tasks, optimize routes, and handle unpredictable events that increase mission difficulty.
projects.challenges: Faced issues with synchronizing player animations and real-time state updates between clients, causing visual lag and desync.
projects.results: Resolved it by implementing Photon Animator View and RPCs to ensure seamless animation syncing and smooth networked movement.

projects.title: Edge of Fate
projects.subtitle: Skill-Based Sword Fighting Game
projects.shortDescription: A precision-based sword combat experience featuring fast-paced melee action and responsive gameplay systems.
projects.fullDescription:
This project is a third-person sword combat game currently in development, focused on building a responsive and satisfying melee combat system. The core experience is designed around precision, timing, and player feedback to create impactful sword fighting encounters.

The system explores key gameplay elements such as combo chaining, attack timing, dodging, and parry mechanics, aiming to achieve a fluid and responsive combat feel. Special attention is given to game feel improvements including animation responsiveness, hit feedback, and camera effects to enhance player immersion.

As an ongoing prototype, the project serves as a technical and design exploration of melee combat systems, with continuous iteration on mechanics and overall gameplay feel.
projects.challenges: Designing a melee combat system that feels responsive and impactful, while balancing animation smoothness with precise player input control.
projects.results: Delivered a functional sword combat prototype featuring responsive controls, combo systems, and improved game feel through refined animation and feedback systems

projects.title: Stylized Room Corner
projects.subtitle: Substance Painter Material Study & UE5 Render
projects.shortDescription: A stylized interior corner scene created using Substance 3D Painter and rendered in Unreal Engine, focusing on material creation, lighting, and look development.
projects.fullDescription:
This project is a stylized environment study focused on material creation and real-time rendering. The assets were textured in Substance 3D Painter with emphasis on hand-painted stylization techniques, color harmony, and surface detail control.

The scene was then assembled and rendered in Unreal Engine, where lighting and composition were carefully adjusted to enhance the stylized aesthetic. The project explores how materials, lighting, and post-processing work together to achieve a cohesive visual style in a real-time engine.

The goal of this study was to improve my understanding of stylized material workflows and environment presentation techniques for game-ready assets.
projects.role: Substance Painter Artist & Unreal Engine Renderer
projects.challenges: Balancing stylized material creation in Substance Painter with realistic lighting constraints in Unreal Engine while maintaining a consistent visual style across the scene.
projects.results: Produced a stylized interior scene with cohesive materials and lighting, successfully demonstrating control over Substance Painter workflows and Unreal Engine rendering techniques for stylized environments.

projects.title: RollIngTeapot
projects.subtitle: Substance Painter Material Study & MAYA Uv Unwrapping
projects.category: UV Unwrapping in Maya & Texturing in Substance Painter
projects.shortDescription: A stylized teapot asset focused on UV unwrapping in Maya and texture creation in Substance Painter
projects.fullDescription:
This project focuses on the complete UV and texturing workflow for a stylized teapot asset. The UV layout was created in Autodesk Maya with attention to clean seams, efficient space usage, and minimal texture distortion.

After UV unwrapping, the asset was imported into Substance 3D Painter for material creation and texture painting. The focus was on achieving stylized material definition, balanced color variation, and surface detail to enhance the visual quality of the model.

The project demonstrates a complete understanding of the UV-to-texturing pipeline used in game asset production.
projects.challenges: Creating clean and efficient UV layouts in Maya while ensuring optimal texture space usage and seamless transition into Substance Painter for high-quality material painting.
projects.results: Delivered a fully textured stylized prop with optimized UV layout and high-quality Substance Painter materials, demonstrating strong understanding of UV mapping and texturing workflow.

about.name: Saif Dababseh
about.title: Game Designer | Environment Artist | Unity Developer
about.bio:
I'm a game designer and environment artist based in Nablus, Palestine, with a deep passion for crafting immersive digital worlds. My work sits at the intersection of technical precision and artistic vision — I believe the best game environments don't just look beautiful, they tell stories.

With hands-on experience in Unity and Unreal Engine 5, I specialize in building environments that feel alive: dynamic lighting, atmospheric particle systems, and world-building that pulls players into alternate realities. My background spans level design, shader development, and game systems design, giving me a holistic understanding of how all the pieces fit together.

I'm currently seeking internship and freelance opportunities where I can contribute to ambitious projects alongside talented teams.
